content: Offline indoor navigation follows the established offline-map pattern used by Google Maps, HERE and Mapbox: the client downloads a region/venue pack ahead of use, stores it locally, and runs routing locally against the cached graph so the whole route works with no network. Mapbox adds predictive caching and an offline manager for the Navigation SDK. Indoor-specific offline literature is thinner and mostly vendor content. Implication for this project: cache the campus graph (nodes, edges, floors, calibration) plus floor-plan images after first fetch, and run the same pathfinding algorithm client-side as the offline fallback; treat the cache as a versioned artifact keyed by a graph revision so it can be invalidated when the admin publishes graph edits.
